pages.name: English: Symmetrical, 3 Knights, 5.e4 Nb4 6.Bb5+
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Black create threats on d3 and c2 while in check from Bb5; plan 1 was vague. Rewrote both plans around 6...N8c6 7.d4 and the queenless main line.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, 3 Knights, 5.e4 Nb4 6.Bc4
pages.notes: Plan 1 named ...Nxc2+ (c2 is empty; the main line is ...Nd3+ 7.Ke2). Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, 3 Knights, 5.e4 Nxc3
pages.notes: Plan 1 described an e4-d4 centre with the d-pawn still on d2, and the overview covered only 6.bxc3. Rewrote overview and both plans to cover 6.dxc3 Qxd1+ and 6.bxc3 with d4.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, 3 Knights, Exchange
pages.notes: Plan 2 read d4 as a Black move; plan 4 targeted a backward black d-pawn that does not exist. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, 2.Nc3 Nc6 3.e3
pages.notes: Plan 3 developed both Nge2 and Be2 to the same square and wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, 2.Nc3 Nc6 3.Nf3 g6 4.e3
pages.notes: Plan 3 wrote the pawn duo as a move (e3-d4); plan 4 rerouted a b8-knight that is already on c6. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Four Knights, 4.e3 e5
pages.notes: Overview predicted an isolated queen's pawn or a Hedgehog, neither of which fits the c5/e5 structure; plan 1 had Black capture ...exd4 against an IQP. Rewrote overview and all three plans.

pages.name: English Opening: Symmetrical Variation, Botvinnik System
pages.notes: Plan 1 told White to play e2-e4 with the pawn already on e4; overview called the structure symmetrical; plans 3-4 were vague. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 3 and 4.

pages.name: English Opening: Symmetrical Variation, Botvinnik System Reversed, with e3
pages.notes: Plan 2 said Black controls d5 to stop d4; overview called Black's set-up White's. Rewrote overview and plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, 5.d3
pages.notes: Plan 2 rerouted a knight via Nd2-f1-e3 and played Re1 before castling; plan 4 said ...e5 challenges the g2-bishop. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.
